data.name: Home_Title
data.value: Mobility scooters, wheelchairs and strollers delivered to your Orlando hotel

data.name: Home_MetaDescription
data.value: Rent a mobility scooter, wheelchair or stroller for the Orlando theme parks. We deliver to your hotel and pick it up when you leave.

data.name: Home_HeroHeadline
data.value: Keep up with your family. Rest when you want.

data.name: Home_HeroSubheadline
data.value: Mobility scooters and wheelchairs delivered to your hotel around the Orlando parks - tested, charged, and sized to fit the Disney buses and the Skyliner.

data.name: Home_AudienceFamilyText
data.value: A park day is ten to fifteen miles of walking. A scooter is how the whole family gets to stay together until the fireworks.

data.name: Home_AudienceMedicalText
data.value: Recovering from surgery, living with arthritis, or with a condition that limits distance: the equipment is here so the trip does not have to be cancelled.

data.name: Home_AudienceSeniorsText
data.value: Grandparents who walk fine at home still face a very long day in the parks. Renting for the week costs less than one missed day.

data.name: Home_ProductsSubtitle
data.value: The price shown is the lowest daily rate of each model. Strollers arrive for the winter season.

data.name: Home_Step1Text
data.value: Tell us the arrival day, the departure day and where you are staying.

data.name: Home_Step2Text
data.value: We bring the equipment to your hotel, tested and charged.

data.name: Home_Step3Text
data.value: The equipment is yours for the whole stay, parks included.

data.name: Home_Step4Text
data.value: Leave it with the front desk, or hand it to us on your last day.

data.name: Rentals_Intro

data.value: Four steps from booking to pick-up, and how the hand-over works at the Disney and Universal resorts.

data.name: HowItWorks_Intro
data.value: Delivery and pick-up are part of the rental. Here is what happens on each day of your stay.

data.name: HowItWorks_MeetTitle
data.value: Why we meet you in person at the Disney resorts

data.name: Faq_MetaDescription
data.value: Age to drive a scooter, charging, park transport, rain, cancellation, strollers and wagons, and what to bring.

data.name: Faq_Q1
data.value: How old do I have to be to drive a mobility scooter?

data.name: Faq_A1
data.value: The driver must be 18 or older. A younger passenger can ride along only on a model that allows a second rider.

data.name: Faq_Q2
data.value: How do I charge the scooter?

data.name: Faq_A2
data.value: Charge it overnight in your room with the charger we leave with you. A full night covers a full park day. Take the key out whenever you park it.

data.name: Faq_Q3
data.value: Does the equipment fit on the park transport?

data.name: Faq_A3
data.value: The Disney buses and the Skyliner take equipment up to 30 by 48 inches, and every model at or under that size carries the badge on its page. Strollers must stay under 31 by 52 inches inside the Disney parks.

data.name: Faq_A4
data.value: Rain does not stop the rental. Park the equipment under cover during a storm and dry the seat before using it again. A rain cover is available for strollers.

data.name: Faq_A5
data.value: Online booking is not open yet, so there is nothing to cancel today. When it opens, the cancellation window will be written on the terms page before you pay.

data.name: Faq_Q6
data.value: Can I bring a wagon into the parks instead?

data.name: Faq_A6
data.value: No. Wagons are not allowed inside the Disney parks, which is why we rent strollers and not wagons.

data.name: Faq_A7
data.value: Nothing. The equipment arrives clean, tested and charged, with everything it needs.

data.name: Faq_Q8
data.value: How do I reach you during the trip?

data.name: Faq_A8
data.value: The contact page carries every way to reach us. A WhatsApp line dedicated to Orlando Up is being set up, and it appears there the day it is live.

data.name: Contact_MetaDescription
data.value: Phone, WhatsApp, e-mail and hours for Orlando Up.

data.name: Contact_Intro
data.value: Call or message us and a person answers.

data.name: Draft_Banner

data.name: Privacy_Body

data.name: Terms_Body
data.value: This page will carry the rental agreement, the cancellation window and the damage rules. It is being written.

data.name: Home_TeamText
data.value: Orlando Up is run by Ronatrip, a travel company based in Orlando. The person who hands you the scooter is the person who answers when you call, and the equipment is ours - not a booking passed on to somebody else.

data.name: Rentals_ComingSoonNote
data.value: We do not have these yet. The stroller fleet arrives for the winter season, and these pages will carry sizes and prices before booking opens.

data.name: Product_ComingSoonNote
data.value: We are buying these for the winter season. Tell us your dates and we will let you know the moment they arrive.

data.name: HowItWorks_AreasCta
data.value: See every area we deliver to

data.name: Delivery_MetaDescription
data.value: The hotels and areas we deliver to around the Orlando parks, and how the hand-over works at each of them.

data.name: Delivery_Intro
data.value: We deliver around the Disney and Universal resorts, along International Drive and Lake Buena Vista, and to the vacation homes near the parks. How the equipment reaches you depends on the rules of the place you are staying.

data.name: Delivery_LocationsNote
data.value: Examples, not a closed list. If your hotel is not named here, ask us - it is very likely in the same zone.

data.name: Delivery_FeeNote
data.value: Delivery and pick-up are quoted with your booking, once we know where you are staying and which days. We would rather give you the real number for your address than publish an average that turns out wrong at the door.

data.name: Faq_Q9
data.value: Can you deliver to a Disney resort hotel?

data.name: Faq_A9
data.value: Yes, and we meet you in person to do it. Disney allows only its featured provider to leave equipment with Bell Services, so we agree a time with you and hand it over at the resort. It takes about five minutes.

data.name: Faq_A10
data.value: Not yet. The stroller fleet arrives for the winter season. The models are already listed on the rentals page, marked as coming soon, and they will carry sizes and prices before booking opens.

data.name: Admin_ProductCreateLead
data.value: Only what the product needs in order to exist. It is created hidden, and the editor opens next so you can fill in the rest and publish it deliberately.

data.name: Admin_BlockPortugueseHelp
data.value: Leave every field of this block empty to remove the Portuguese text entirely. The product list then shows it as missing.

data.name: Admin_BlockPricingHelp
data.value: Bands start at one day, never cover the same length twice, and the longest one has no upper limit. Leave the maximum empty for the open-ended band. A row left blank is not a band.

data.name: Admin_NoAddOns
data.value: There is no active add-on to link.

data.name: Admin_FieldSlugHelp
data.value: The English URL segment. Stable after publication: changing it breaks every link already shared.

data.name: Admin_MeasurementsHelp
data.value: A measurement nobody took is an empty field, not a zero. Numbers use the English format: a dot for the decimal separator.

data.name: Admin_FieldIsBookableHelp
data.value: A product can only go on sale with a complete price list. A product that is not on sale carries no price band and no add-on.

data.name: Admin_FieldDescriptionHelp
data.value: Markdown. The public page renders it; this screen does not preview it.

data.name: Admin_FieldHighlightsHelp
data.value: One per line. A blank line is not a highlight.

data.name: Admin_FieldAssetTagHelp
data.value: Unique across the whole fleet, as it is written on the machine.

data.name: Admin_AuditLead
data.value: The hundred most recent changes, newest first.

data.name: Admin_ErrorNumberFormat
data.value: A value could not be read. Numbers use the English format: a dot for the decimal separator and no thousands separator.

data.name: Admin_ErrorEnglishNameRequired
data.value: The name in English is required.

data.name: Admin_ErrorSlugRequired
data.value: The address is required and is at most 80 characters.

data.name: Admin_ErrorSlugTaken
data.value: Another product already uses this address.

data.name: Admin_ErrorNotBookableCarriesPrice
data.value: A product that is not on sale carries no price band. A price nobody can pay is the number a visitor remembers.

data.name: Admin_ErrorNotBookableCarriesAddOn
data.value: A product that is not on sale carries no add-on link.

data.name: Admin_ErrorTierEmpty
data.value: A product on sale needs at least one price band.

data.name: Admin_ErrorTierInvalidBand
data.value: A band starts below one day, ends before it starts, asks for an amount of zero or less, or is missing the days or the amount.

data.name: Admin_ErrorTierDoesNotStartAtOneDay
data.value: The shortest band does not start at one day.

data.name: Admin_ErrorTierOverlap
data.value: Two bands cover the same rental length.

data.name: Admin_ErrorTierGap
data.value: A rental length between the shortest and the longest band has no price.

data.name: Admin_ErrorTierNoOpenEndedBand
data.value: Every band has an upper limit, so a long rental would have no price. Leave the maximum of the longest band empty.

data.name: Admin_ErrorAssetTagRequired
data.value: The asset tag is required and is at most 40 characters.

data.name: Admin_ErrorAssetTagTaken
data.value: Another unit already carries this asset tag.

data.name: Admin_ErrorProductRequired
data.value: Choose the product this unit belongs to.

data.name: Admin_FieldBatteryKindHelp
data.value: What the battery is, not how it is allocated: an extended-range battery keeps every promise a normal one keeps, so availability counts them together.

data.name: Admin_FieldBatteryRangeHelp
data.value: Leave it empty when nobody has measured this one. Empty is not zero.

data.name: Admin_FieldBatteryTagHelp
data.value: Unique across the whole fleet, as it is written on the battery.

data.name: Admin_FieldBatteryProductHelp
data.value: The scooter model. Only scooter models carry batteries.

data.name: Admin_ErrorBatteryTagRequired
data.value: The asset tag is required and is at most 40 characters.

data.name: Admin_ErrorBatteryTagTaken
data.value: Another battery already carries this asset tag.

data.name: Admin_ErrorBatteryNeedsScooter
data.value: A battery belongs to a scooter model.

data.name: Admin_SettingsLead
data.value: The numbers the operation changes without a deploy.

data.name: Admin_FieldChargerCountHelp
data.value: A count and not a list: any charger fits any battery of either model.

data.name: Admin_FieldSecondBatteryHelp
data.value: The amount a reservation starts with. It can be changed on the reservation, and zero is a legitimate value.

data.name: Admin_FieldLostChargerHelp
data.value: What a replacement costs, so it changes when that cost changes.

data.name: Admin_ErrorSettingsMissing
data.value: The settings row does not exist in this database. It is created by the migration, and this screen deliberately does not create one.

data.name: Admin_ErrorChargerCountNegative
data.value: The charger count cannot be negative.
